description: Calculate an instant valuation estimate (ZAR) for a customer looking to trade in or sell their used golf clubs to WeBuyClubz, grounded in 1,800+ verified South African trade-in offers, including estimated cash payout and +15% store credit bonus.

brand.description: Brand name (e.g. TaylorMade, Callaway, Titleist, Ping, Cobra, Mizuno, Cleveland)

club_type.description: Golf Set, Ladies Golf Set, Iron Set, Driver, Fairway Wood, Hybrid, Wedge, Putter, Junior Set, Golf Bag

condition.description: Condition label (mint, excellent, good, fair) if condition_rating is omitted

condition_rating.description: Condition rating out of 10 (5 to 10, default: 7)

model_name.description: Exact club model (e.g. Qi10, SIM2 Max, Rogue ST Max, Stealth, G430)

name: estimate_trade_in_value
